messages.content: An alert fired for high CPU on a batch worker, but the worker completed normally and CPU returned to baseline within two minutes.

observed_facts: CPU returned to baseline within two minutes
hypotheses: the alert threshold may not account for normal batch-workload peaks
next_steps: Record the event for alert-tuning review
Check whether similar alerts occur during normal batch windows
Continue monitoring without changing production thresholds immediately
